summary: The lockfile resolves @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin 8.73.0 with its supported TypeScript 6.0.3 peer range; npm ci, lint, tests, and build all passed locally.

verification.rationale: A clean npm ci completed successfully using the committed package manifest and lockfile, and the resolved dependency tree reports eslint-plugin 8.73.0 using TypeScript 6.0.3 within its declared >=4.8.4 <6.1.0 peer range.
limitations: The local verification used Node.js 24; CI will independently run npm ci on Node.js 20 and 22.

references.result: @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin 8.73.0 declares the compatible TypeScript peer range.
